title: fix(plugin-dashboard): a compare widget dated on a related record's field is served through the declared date dimension over that path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoH1SLb7yGpZj1NnaFvhbT6W)_
Fixes #34350

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 仪表板作者：按关联记录的日期（例如客户的签约日期）做同期对比的比较型小组件，以前被数据集查询直接拒绝；现在只要数据集在那条关联路径上声明了一个日期维度，对比就能正常算出并显示。
- 属于仪表板数据集组件的同期对比，补上数据集只认已声明成员之后留下的缺口（替仪表板作者解决）。
- 出错时：没有覆盖该路径的日期维度，或有两个以上时，小组件照旧显示数据集查询的拒绝信息，不会显示猜出来的数字；本改动可直接撤回，撤回后回到原来的拒绝。
- 无

## What changes

Seat ruling 6911721875 on #34005 keeps the dataset door's refusal of an undeclared member and leaves one thing open: the renderer mapping a dotted date key to a declared dimension over that path. This PR is that mapping, in the dashboard renderer only. Nothing under `packages/spec`, the dataset door or the executor changes.

- `DatasetWidget` (dataset-bound widget with `compareTo`): when a closed date window in the widget's resolved filter is keyed on a field that cannot be a dimension name (judged by the spec's own `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema`, so a dotted `relationship.field`), the widget reads the dataset definition (`GET /api/v1/meta/dataset/NAME`, through the host's `apiFetch`, with `callerPackage` when the dashboard has a served package, the same read the dataset chart and the report date range make) and sends that window under the declared dimension's name. The query waits for the read.
- `mapCompareWindowKeys` decides the rename:
  - mapped: exactly one declared dimension with `type: 'date'` whose `field` equals the key, spelled exactly;
  - left as authored (so the door's existing `400 INVALID_FIELD` answers): zero such dimensions; two or more (no guess between two declarations); a dimension over the path without `type: 'date'`; a declared name another window already uses or two keys would share; a failed definition read.
  - A key that can be a dimension name (`close_date`) is never renamed, and a widget with no such key reads nothing; its query is byte-identical to before.
- `compareTo.dimension` naming the window by the path or by the declared name is sent as the declared name, so the executor's dimension resolution sees the same name the window carries.
- `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, "The Date Key of a Compare Widget": its paragraph said declaring a dimension over the path "does not help"; that became false with this change, so it now states the declaration that serves the window and when the key is still refused. This file is outside the claim's file surface and is declared here.

### Keys the mapping serves (for the compare-widget date-key save gate, #34308)

A compare window's date key reaches the dataset query as a declared name when either holds:

1. the key is itself a declared dimension name (unchanged; no read, no rename); or
2. the key cannot be a dimension name and the dataset declares exactly one dimension with `type: 'date'` and `field` equal to the key.

Every other key goes out as authored and is refused by the door. A save gate that accepts exactly these two cases accepts exactly what the renderer can serve.

## Tests

New pin `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.compareWindowPathKey-34350.test.tsx` (13 tests), against a stand-in for the door's declared-member rule:

- the dotted window served through the one declared date dimension over the path (definition read once, as the reader, before the only query; window moved out of `runtimeFilter`; tile renders the value);
- `compareTo.dimension` written as the path or as the declared name both go out as the declared name;
- the refusal when no declared date dimension covers the path: key sent as authored, `code` `INVALID_FIELD` and `status` 400, refusal shown on the tile; the same for two covering dimensions and for a failed definition read;
- no definition read for an own-object key or a widget without `compareTo`;
- `mapCompareWindowKeys` unit cases for every branch above.

<details><summary>Readings (head ffebb0ed)</summary>

- `vitest run` on the new pin plus `DatasetWidget.compareTo.test.tsx` and `DashboardRenderer.compareToAllTime-25970.test.tsx`: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 52 passed, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` (whole package): Test Files 207 passed (207), Tests 2023 passed, 6 skipped, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0; the test project's file list includes the new pin (1 hit).
- Ablation 1, mapping disabled (`over.length === 1` to `over.length === -1`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob c40bc3e3 to 986c24cc): 3 failed (the unit map case, the served window, the `compareTo.dimension` rename), 10 passed; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, ambiguity guessed (`over.length >= 1`): 2 failed (both two-declarations cases), 11 passed; restored, blob equals HEAD.
- The test imports the widget from source, not through a package `dist`, so no rebuild leg applies.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Dimensions over the path that omit `type` are not mapped: the rule reads only what the dataset declares, as the card asks for the declared date dimension.
- An identifier key that is a field of the base object but not a declared dimension name (for example `close_date` under a dimension named `closed_on`) stays as authored. That case has a declare-it remedy at the door and is outside this card.
- The definition read is one extra request per widget only for a compare widget whose window is keyed on a path. It is not cached across widgets; the dataset chart and the report make the same uncached read.
- The door's refusal wording for a key no dimension can be named still says the comparison needs a date field of the dataset's own object. With this mapping, a declared date dimension over the path also serves it. That text lives in the analytics service, outside this claim, and is reported to the seat rather than edited here.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `DatasetWidget.tsx`, the compare-window block in the component (`pathWindowKeys`, `useCompareWindowKeyMap`, `comparedKey`, the signature and the early return in the fetch effect): the query must not go out while the read is pending, and must not refetch in a loop.
2. `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `mapCompareWindowKeys`: the zero / two-or-more / collision branches.
3. `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, "The Date Key of a Compare Widget".

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.compareWindowPathKey-34350.test.tsx`, expect 13 passed.
